name: Cozy Home Reno
derivedFrom: reference: House Flipper + cozy warm home-renovation mobile game art, soft and inviting

artDirection.theme: warm cozy American living-room flooring renovation, soft inviting home interior

negative: no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos with words
no harsh black cast shadow on the ground

assets.subject: a cozy two-seat fabric sofa in warm caramel-brown with plump cushions, viewed STRAIGHT FROM DIRECTLY ABOVE (flat top-down bird's-eye floor-plan view), seeing the tops of the seat cushions, backrest and both armrests, no side or front elevation, perfectly centered

a cozy rectangular woven area rug lying flat on the floor, viewed STRAIGHT FROM DIRECTLY ABOVE (flat top-down bird's-eye view), soft warm tan and cream tones with a subtle woven texture and a gentle frayed fabric edge, looks like real soft fabric not a cut-out sticker, perfectly centered

a square patch of OLD ROTTEN wooden plank floor seen straight top-down: dark grey-brown weathered boards, deep jagged cracks, greenish mold patches, dark water stains, one broken plank with a black hole, a bent rusty nail sticking up, warped gaps between boards, damaged and neglected

a square patch of BRAND NEW warm honey-oak wooden plank floor seen straight top-down, clean fresh straight planks, smooth subtle wood grain, glossy clean finish catching soft warm light, pristine and inviting
a single red steel crowbar pry-bar tool, clean recognizable silhouette, perfectly centered
a single fresh warm-oak wooden floor plank, clean recognizable silhouette, perfectly centered
a single paint roller tool with a green handle applying glossy finish, clean recognizable silhouette, perfectly centered
a friendly flooring-company emblem: a simple warm house silhouette sitting on a small swatch of wooden plank floor inside a rounded badge, wordless icon only, perfectly centered and symmetric
